grh_cf2a670c042316f3b802.title: Every Frame Has a Silver Lining
paragraphs: Harry follows a seemingly respectable family because a valuable picture in a silver frame appears to offer a profitable opportunity, only to discover that Helen and her supposed relatives are part of an opium-smuggling ring. Harry and Helen temporarily join forces, tie up the others and wait for the money, with Helen proposing that they become permanent partners. When police arrive, Harry switches sides without hesitation, claiming he forced Helen to reveal the gang and directing the officers to the smugglers and their drugs. He collects the government reward and later insists that he opposed narcotics on principle, while admitting the size of the reward made honesty particularly attractive.

Harry finally holds a police inspector at gunpoint long enough for Helena to cross into Austria, while he stays behind and bargains away his automobile to buy his own escape. grh_cf782f782e2aba5ac0fe.title: Nuptial Flight
paragraphs: A newlywed couple crossing a vast, empty stretch of highway are terrorized by three young men in a faster car who repeatedly cut them off and threaten them. The harassment exposes strains in the marriage and the bride's previously unrecognized terror of open country; even a remote service-station owner refuses to let them use his phone because he fears the local men. With nowhere to hide or get help, the couple finally turns the chase around and forces the pursuing car off the road. It overturns and burns, and the newlyweds choose to drive on rather than stop, grimly rationalizing what has happened.
